title: 1.2.28 A1.2.1 — Fix Ten Declarations
description: Ten broken variable declarations. Fix each one and say in a comment what was wrong. Auto-graded.

steps.title: Fix the syntax errors
steps.instructions: Several declarations are missing a keyword, a quote mark, or an equals sign. Repair them so the file runs.

steps.title: Fix the wrong types
steps.instructions: Some values are the wrong type for what the name says — a number written as text, a boolean written as text. Give each the type its name implies.

steps.title: Fix the names
steps.instructions: Some names are single letters or not camelCase. Rename them to descriptive camelCase names.

steps.title: Comment every fix
steps.instructions: Above each declaration you changed, write a // comment saying what was wrong. Ten fixes, ten comments.

requirements.title: studentAge is a number
requirements.description: studentAge is declared and holds a number, not text

requirements.title: firstName is a string
requirements.description: firstName is declared and holds properly quoted text

requirements.title: isEnrolled is a real boolean
requirements.description: isEnrolled holds true or false without quotes

requirements.title: gradeLevel is declared with a keyword
requirements.description: gradeLevel uses let or const rather than being assigned with no keyword

requirements.title: MAX_STUDENTS is a const
requirements.description: The value that never changes is declared with const

requirements.title: unitPrice replaces the single-letter name
requirements.description: The mystery name p has been renamed to unitPrice

requirements.title: itemCount replaces the second mystery name
requirements.description: The mystery name q has been renamed to itemCount

requirements.title: favouriteColour is camelCase
requirements.description: The snake_case or all-lowercase name has become camelCase

requirements.title: middleName is null, not the string "null"
requirements.description: The deliberately-empty value uses the null keyword without quotes

requirements.title: finalScore is declared but left unassigned
requirements.description: finalScore is declared with let and no value, so it holds undefined until set
